items.title: 蘋果傳縮減員工AI費用額度，工程人員可能降到每天100美元
items.summary: 彭博報導由於AI支出高漲，蘋果近日在非工程人員之外，進一步縮減部分工程師員工每月的AI使用預算。 報導引述消息來源指出，蘋果內部已將部分工程師的AI預算由每天300美元減為200美元，而且有些工程師的AI預算將減至每天100美元。但也有少部分員工還維持每天300美元的額度。

items.title: SpaceX攜手高通建置全美5G網路，2027年起部署數萬座基地臺
items.summary: 美國太空公司SpaceX繼利用Starlink衛星提供網路服務後，也準備在美國大規模建置地面5G網路。高通（Qualcomm）周三（11/4）宣布，SpaceX將採用旗下Dragonwing技術建置5G基地臺，預計2027年開始部署，未來數年間將設置數萬個站點。SpaceX希望結合衛星與地面5G網路，提供覆蓋全美的行動通訊服務。

items.title: 毛寶電商網站遭不明人士攻擊，已通報主管機關並通知受影響顧客
items.summary: 上市生活清潔用品製造商毛寶（1732）於11月3日，在股市公開資訊觀測站發布重大訊息，該公司透過例行性資安監控機制，發現電商網站遭外部不明人士進行異常網路攻擊，隨即啟動資安應變機制因應。

items.title: fix(oc-path): find rejects quoted filenames containing question marks…
items.summary: fix(oc-path): find rejects quoted filenames containing question marks (#193123) fix(path): allow quoted literal ? filenames in path find `openclaw path find` refused a quoted literal filename containing `?`, even though `path resolve` opens the same file. The parser already separates the query from the filename; the later guard wrongly treated `?` as a wildcard. Now only `*` is refused. Path resolution, other guards, query handling and the SDK are unchanged. Evidence: built Linux CLI on Node 24.22.1. Main refused quoted `?` filenames; with this change find returns both expected values, and every returned path resolves correctly. Ordinary files are unchanged, `*` is still refused, and file hashes are unchanged after every command. Details: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/193123#issuecomment-6648529261. Thanks @zhangguiping-xydt. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.title: fix(process): forward-port startup cleanup and shared lineage fixes (…
items.summary: fix(process): forward-port startup cleanup and shared lineage fixes (#192386) * fix(process): preserve loaded startup cleanup Co-authored-by: RomneyDa Forward-port of ba42adbc70 from release/2026.10.10. * fix(process): keep stdio startup failures ahead of cleanup errors When an owned stdio process failed to start and its cleanup also failed, the relay host rethrew the cleanup rejection instead of the anchor's startup error, and owned stdio replaced the message again with "stdio startup cleanup did not confirm closure". The Docker CLI backend lane only showed the identity-loss cleanup error, never why startup failed. Throw the startup failure first with the cleanup failure as a secondary AggregateError member, and lead the owned stdio message with the startup failure plus the next step (restart the Gateway before retrying). On main this also changes the refused-launch hard-deadline case from #187137: the refusal now leads and the hard-deadline cleanup failure follows as the secondary member; the cleanup fence itself is unchanged. Forward-port of e51fa6420f from release/2026.10.10. * fix(process): share inherited process lineage across module copies The CLI backend live lane runs its Gateway from source under vitest while bundled plugins load from dist. The anthropic plugin's openclaw/plugin-sdk import is natively aliased to the source SDK, so src/process/supervisor loads a second time outside vitest's graph. That copy never saw the test's bindInheritedNativeProcessOwner(dist anchor) and fell back to the source anchor. Inherited lineage fds and the native process owner are process state, so keep them in one global singleton slot that every module copy shares. Forward-port of 7dc3350cb9 from release/2026.10.10. * test(ci): scope process forward-port regression allocation * test(process): use deterministic startup cleanup clocks --------- Co-authored-by: roboclaw-bot
